questions.prompt: Which of these actors have played James Bond?
questions.fact: Seven actors have played him on film. Sean Connery was the first and almost turned it down.

questions.prompt: Which of these were wonders of the ancient world?
questions.fact: Only the Great Pyramid still stands. The other six were listed by Greek writers and are all long gone.

questions.prompt: How many lines are there in a sonnet?
questions.fact: Fourteen, always. The last two usually turn the argument of the first twelve on its head.

questions.prompt: How long can a giant tortoise live, in years?
questions.fact: Well past 150. One taken from the Galapagos by Charles Darwin's crew was still alive in a zoo in 2006.

questions.prompt: Which vegetable is sauerkraut made from?
questions.hint: Shredded, salted and left to sour in a jar.
questions.fact: Salt draws the water out and the vegetable pickles itself. Sailors ate it to keep scurvy off on long voyages.

questions.prompt: What is the money of the United Kingdom called?
questions.hint: Its symbol is a crossed L.
questions.fact: The pound is the oldest currency still in use. It began as a literal pound of silver, split into 240 pennies.
